patches.title: Clean Verb on Sink
patches.principle: To clean an object, you must use the 'clean' action while at the sink; moving it there is not enough.
patches.when_to_apply: When you are at the sink holding a dirty object.

patches.title: Cool and Retrieve from Fridge
patches.principle: For cooling, place the object in the fridge, then take it out before final placement.
patches.when_to_apply: When you need to cool an object and have reached the fridge.

patches.title: Skip Containers if Target Visible
patches.principle: If the target object is visible on an open surface, do not open any containers; grab it immediately.
patches.when_to_apply: When you spot the task object on a countertop or other open surface.
